summary: Retest of the iteration 10 raffle fixes. Backend: 18 of 18 pytest tests pass (3 new in test_raffle_iter11.py plus 15 regression tests). 1) entries() now takes the name from the painel cache. A temp paid payment for 227470206 with 2 clovers shows as 'joaonew' in the pool, the GET /api/raffle entries, the winner, every DrawReel sequence item and the admin alert. 2) The prize renewal uses the winner's real system type. With prize_months=3, the p2p user joaonew was renewed with package_id=42 (iptv would be 43), user_id=227470206 and months=3 (painel.renew_user was mocked). 3) Lock release: a failure inside _draw_locked before update_one (config raising) deleted the 'drawing' raffle_draws doc, so the month is not blocked. A failure in _notify after update_one leaves the doc as 'drawn', which is correct because the draw and renewal already happened. 4) find_or_create_customer called with the legacy 12-digit form does not downgrade an existing 13-digit canonical row. The 12→13 upgrade still works. Frontend /sorteio: the prize select is aligned with the inputs (same y=358, height 36px, radius, border, transparent background, no margin-top). The Ativo switch is green (rgb(16,185,129)) when on. The participants list shows 'joaonew 2 🍀 · #00001, #00002' with the temp payment. All data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: After the legacy 12→13 upgrade, the returned dict still holds the old 12-digit whatsapp value (existing = dict(row) is read before the UPDATE). Cosmetic, because callers already hold the canonical phone.
The dead condition 'pool is not None' is still there, and the LEFT JOIN customers on c.id = p.customer_id is now only a fallback that never matches.

critical_code_review_comments: find_or_create_customer returns the stale whatsapp after the upgrade. Set existing['whatsapp'] = phone after the UPDATE.
Remove the always-true 'pool is not None' check in raffle.entries()
